info.title: Astra Astrology API
info.description:
Backend for the **Astra Astrology** platform — astrology, numerology and
astrologer consultations.

* `auth` — registration via email+password (OTP verified) and Google sign-in,
  kept in sync between MongoDB and Firebase Auth
* `health` — liveness and readiness

Address.title: Address
Address.description: A delivery address for the store.

AstrologerAdminUpdate.title: AstrologerAdminUpdate
AstrologerAdminUpdate.description: Everything the astrologer can change, plus what only the platform can.

AstrologerCreate.title: AstrologerCreate
AstrologerCreate.description:
What an admin fills in to open an astrologer's account.

No password field: one is generated and emailed to the astrologer, because
nobody — not even the admin — should be choosing someone else's password.

initial_password.title: Initial Password
initial_password.description: Only filled in when the welcome email could not be sent, so the admin can pass the password on another way.

AstrologerCreated.title: AstrologerCreated
AstrologerCreated.description: Returned once, when an admin opens the account.

must_change_password.title: Must Change Password
must_change_password.description: True until the astrologer replaces the password they were emailed

AstrologerProfile.title: AstrologerProfile
AstrologerProfile.description: The astrologer's own view, and the admin's.

AstrologerPublic.title: AstrologerPublic
AstrologerPublic.description:
What the website and app may show about an astrologer.

Deliberately narrower than `AstrologerProfile`: no email, phone, bank
details, commission or account status — this is served to anyone.

AstrologerUpdate.title: AstrologerUpdate
AstrologerUpdate.description:
What the astrologer may change about themselves.

Rates, commission and the curation flags are absent on purpose — those are
the platform's to set, not the astrologer's.

AuthProvider.title: AuthProvider
AuthProvider.description: How an account can be signed in to. A user may have more than one.

is_time_known.title: Is Time Known
is_time_known.description: False means only a limited chart can be produced

timezone_offset.title: Timezone Offset
timezone_offset.description: Hours from UTC at the moment of birth

BirthDetails.title: BirthDetails
BirthDetails.description: Everything the chart engine needs to place the planets.

BirthDetailsInput.title: BirthDetailsInput
BirthDetailsInput.description: Every field optional — a PATCH merges into whatever is already stored.

CallCredentials.title: CallCredentials
CallCredentials.description:
Everything the SDK needs, and nothing it does not.

The ServerSecret is absent on purpose — it signs the token here and never
leaves the server.

CallPeer.title: CallPeer
CallPeer.description: Who is on the other end, for the call screen.

CallStatus.title: CallStatus
CallStatus.description:
Where a call is in its life.

Every path out of `RINGING` is recorded separately, because "the astrologer
said no" and "the astrologer never picked up" mean different things to the
person waiting, and later to whoever is paid.

current_password.title: Current Password
current_password.description: Required unless the account has no password yet

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: At least 6 characters (required by Firebase Auth).

ChangePasswordRequest.title: ChangePasswordRequest
ChangePasswordRequest.description: Changing the password while signed in.

ChatStatus.title: ChatStatus
ChatStatus.description:
Where a chat is in its life.

Mirrors a call's states but with names that read right for a conversation:
nothing "rings", it waits to be picked up.

coins_per_rupee.title: Coins Per Rupee
coins_per_rupee.description: How many coins one rupee buys. A whole number, so a whole-rupee recharge can never produce a fractional coin.

CurrentLocation.title: CurrentLocation
CurrentLocation.description: Where the person is now. Panchang is calculated for this, not for birth.

exists_in.title: Exists In
exists_in.description: Where the email was found: mongodb and/or firebase

password.title: Password
password.description: At least 6 characters (required by Firebase Auth).

EmailRegisterRequest.title: EmailRegisterRequest
EmailRegisterRequest.description: Step 1 of manual sign-up — details in, OTP out.

EmailRegisterVerify.title: EmailRegisterVerify
EmailRegisterVerify.description: Step 2 of manual sign-up — OTP in, account out.

FirebaseCredentials.title: FirebaseCredentials
FirebaseCredentials.description:
What the browser needs to reach Firestore as itself.

The custom token is short-lived and single-purpose: it only proves which
Firebase user this is, so the rules can check participation.

ForgotPasswordRequest.title: ForgotPasswordRequest
ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Step 1 of a password reset — the registered email address.

GalleryImage.title: GalleryImage
GalleryImage.description: A gallery picture. The public_id is kept so it can be deleted again.

GoogleAuthRequest.title: GoogleAuthRequest
GoogleAuthRequest.description: The Firebase ID token the client gets after Google sign-in.

dev_code.title: Dev Code
dev_code.description: Only set when the server runs with OTP_DEV_MODE=true

PasswordLogin.title: PasswordLogin
PasswordLogin.description: Sign in to an existing account with its email and password.

chart_ready.title: Chart Ready
chart_ready.description: Birth date, coordinates and timezone are all on file

panchang_ready.title: Panchang Ready
panchang_ready.description: Current coordinates and timezone are on file

numerology_ready.title: Numerology Ready
numerology_ready.description: Date of birth is on file

ProfileCompleteness.title: ProfileCompleteness
ProfileCompleteness.description: What the client still needs before each feature can run.

ProfileUpdate.title: ProfileUpdate
ProfileUpdate.description:
Partial update. Only the fields present in the body are touched.

`extra="forbid"` is deliberate: `email` is the sign-in identity and is not
editable here, so an attempt to change it fails loudly instead of being
quietly dropped. It also turns a misspelt field name into an error rather
than a silent no-op.

RateCard.title: RateCard
RateCard.description: Per-minute pricing. `offer_*`, when set, is what the user actually pays.

RechargeLimitsUpdate.title: RechargeLimitsUpdate
RechargeLimitsUpdate.description: Either may be sent on its own; the other keeps its current value.

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: At least 6 characters (required by Firebase Auth).

ResetPasswordRequest.title: ResetPasswordRequest
ResetPasswordRequest.description: Step 2 of a password reset — the emailed code and the new password.

Skill.title: Skill
Skill.description: Services an astrologer can offer, from the client's spec.

TransactionReason.title: TransactionReason
TransactionReason.description:
Why money moved. Every future money feature already has its slot here,
so adding payouts or coupons later needs no schema change.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: The full profile, returned by the /users/me endpoints.

VerifyPaymentRequest.title: VerifyPaymentRequest
VerifyPaymentRequest.description: Exactly the three fields Razorpay Checkout hands back.

WalletSummary.title: WalletSummary
WalletSummary.description: What the wallet screen needs in one call.
